purpose: The decoder's presence-logit clamp is a silent no-op: `intermediate_layer_presence_logits.clamp(min=..., max=...)` is NOT in-place and its return value was discarded, so with clamp_presence_logits=True (the default) and clamp_presence_logit_max_val=10.0 the logits were never actually clamped and could saturate to +/-18, tripping the gamma=0 Triton focal-loss backward NaN. This patch assigns the clamp result back so it takes effect (a working +/-10 clamp keeps 1 - p_t ~ 4.5e-5, above the underflow that produces Inf in the Triton kernel). Defense-in-depth alongside the loss-fns gamma==0 fallback fix; aligns with SAM3 PR #576. Target: sam3/model/decoder.py TransformerDecoder.forward presence-logit clamp.
